title: Retirement or education savings account comparison (401k/IRA/529)
description: Research retirement and education savings account options and score their fit against a family's stated goals and timeline.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: retirement-account-comparison
  title: Retirement or education savings account comparison (401k/IRA/529)
  description: Research retirement and education savings account options and score their fit against a family's stated goals and timeline.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Provide general informational research comparing 401k, IRA, and 529 account options against a family's stated goals and timeline, and a fit score, without giving financial advice.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Family goals, timeline, and constraints
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The family's savings goals, time horizon, income situation, and any employer plan details. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: account-researcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Retirement and education account researcher
      role: Careful, non-advisory researcher on retirement and education savings accounts.
      prompt: Research the general characteristics of 401k, traditional and Roth IRA, and 529 accounts relevant to the family's stated goals, timeline, and constraints, including contribution limits, tax treatment, and withdrawal rules. State plainly that this is general informational research only, not financial advice, and recommend the family confirm any decision with a licensed financial advisor before acting. List open questions for that advisor.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, finance-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: fit-score
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Goal and timeline fit score
      role: Independent evaluator of account fit against the family's stated goals.
      prompt: Score how well each researched account type fits the family's stated goals, timeline, and constraints. This is general informational research only, not financial advice; recommend the family confirm the final choice with a licensed financial advisor before acting. Return score, passed, and reasons.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.75 }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Account comparison and fit score
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: account-researcher, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: account-researcher, to: fit-score, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: fit-score, to: result, kind: data }
